verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents that Buildkite builds appear on a repository's CI tab and as checks on pull requests. For GitHub-synced repositories, GitHub Actions results arrive as checks, and rulesets can require those checks to pass. Missing for 10: a documented generic commit-status/checks API so any external CI can report, explicit evidence of checks shown on individual commits (not just pull requests), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
